excerpts: api/views e2d5-ggg7: 12 columns: Data As Of / Jurisdiction (occurrence) / Group / Subgroup / Year of Death (12-month ending year) / Month of Death / Time Period / Month Ending Date / Maternal Deaths (ICD-10 A34, O00-O95, O98-O99) / Live Births (12-month-ending) / Maternal Mortality Rate / Footnote (suppressed 1-9). Description: national-level provisional rates per 100000 live births from NVSS current flow; 12-month-ending periods (compare year-to-year, not month-to-month); rates <20 deaths suppressed (NCHS reliability); counts 1-9 suppressed (confidentiality); quarterly updates with revisions of prior releases. Suggested citation DOI 10.15620/cdc/20250305011; technical notes https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/vsrr/provisional-maternal-deaths.htm (referenced, not fetched).
